pixelRatioCap._comment: Maximum device pixel ratio used by WebGL.

shadowMapSize._comment: Square sun-shadow map size in pixels; use a power of two.

fogNear._comment: Retained legacy fog near distance; distance fog is currently disabled.

fogFar._comment: Retained legacy fog far distance; distance fog is currently disabled.

environmentSaturation._comment: Environment-only saturation multiplier before tone mapping; actors and UI retain their original colors.

skyStorm._comment: Storm sky color blended by cloud coverage.

sunOffset._comment: Sun offset from the followed camera center, in world XYZ.

hemisphereFlashScale._comment: Hemisphere contribution from the shared lightning flash.

stormSkyBlend._comment: Sky-color interpolation amount per unit of cloud coverage.

portraitAspect._comment: Aspect ratio below which portrait framing is selected.

previewPortraitHeight._comment: Orthographic preview view height in portrait.

previewLandscapeHeight._comment: Orthographic preview view height in landscape.

playPortraitHeight._comment: Orthographic gameplay view height in portrait.

playLandscapeHeight._comment: Orthographic gameplay view height in landscape.

previewPortraitOffsetX._comment: Preview center X offset from spawn in portrait.

previewLandscapeOffsetX._comment: Preview center X offset from spawn in landscape.

previewOffsetZ._comment: Preview center Z offset from spawn.

followOffsetZ._comment: Gameplay center Z offset that cancels the ground look-at offset.

previewFollowRate._comment: Preview center interpolation rate per second.

playFollowRate._comment: Gameplay center interpolation rate per second.

lagFraction._comment: Maximum camera lag as a fraction of each half-view dimension.

positionY._comment: Camera elevation above the followed center.

positionOffsetZ._comment: Camera Z offset from the followed center.

lookOffsetZ._comment: Ground look-at Z offset from the followed center.

sceneryMargin._comment: Extra sphere radius preserving scenery silhouettes and shadows.

animalMargin._comment: Extra animal sphere radius preserving limbs and short shadows.

scaleGrowth._comment: Additional eased level-title scale during the introduction.

signHoldSeconds._comment: How long the destination label remains fully visible during play.

celebrationParticles._comment: Particle count in one completion celebration.

maxBarkRings._comment: Hard retained bark-ring cap for repeated input and QA.

barkExpansion._comment: Bark-ring radius growth over its lifetime.

viewDepth._comment: Maximum world depth represented by the scrolling minimap.

bodyChance._comment: Independent seeded chance that a persistent water body has standing grass or reeds.

maximumClumps._comment: Maximum vegetation clumps per selected water body.

areaPerClump._comment: Water surface area in square world metres per target clump.

edgeFalloffMeters._comment: Distance from bank clearance over which placement acceptance decays; smaller values favor banks more strongly.

grassHeight._comment: Typical standing grass blade height above water in world metres, before seeded variation.

reedHeight._comment: Typical reed stem height above water in world metres, before seeded variation.

groundSpacing._comment: Maximum rolling ground grid spacing in world units; smooth gradient normals hide triangle boundaries.

surfaceSpacing._comment: Maximum horizontal edge for terrain-following roads, goal decals and river surfaces.
